author: Kif Leswing
title: Apple sold more watches than Rolex, Swatch, and the rest of the Swiss watch industry combined (AAPL)
text: Apple sold more watches than Rolex, Swatch, and the rest of the Swiss watch industry combined (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Feb 10, 2018, 9:00 am 27 pts A new estimate suggests that Apple sold more watches than the entire Swiss watch industry last quarter. Estimates suggest Apple sold about 8 million watches during the holiday quarter. The comparison shows the accelerating sales growth of Apple's smartwatch platform. Apple is one of the biggest…
